title: Company Overview
text: NovaTech Solutions is a fictional software company founded in 2023. Its headquarters is in Noida, India.

title: Company Departments
text: NovaTech Solutions has three departments: Artificial Intelligence, Data Engineering, and Cloud Infrastructure.

title: NovaMind Launch
text: NovaTech Solutions launched its internal AI assistant called NovaMind in February 2026.

title: NovaMind Purpose
text: NovaMind is designed to answer employee questions about company policies, projects, internal documentation, and technical procedures.

title: NovaMind Project Leadership
text: The NovaMind project was led by Priya Mehta, who is the fictional Head of Artificial Intelligence at NovaTech Solutions.

title: AtlasHub Platform
text: NovaTech Solutions uses a fictional internal knowledge platform called AtlasHub to store engineering documentation.

title: AtlasHub Contents
text: AtlasHub contains documentation for APIs, deployment procedures, incident response processes, and internal coding standards.

title: AI Launchpad Training
text: NovaTech Solutions has a fictional employee training program called AI Launchpad. The program lasts six weeks and covers Python, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, and AI agents.

title: AI Launchpad Certification
text: Employees who complete AI Launchpad receive a fictional internal certification called Nova AI Engineer Level 1.

title: Weekly Technical Review
text: The fictional NovaTech engineering team holds its weekly technical review meeting every Friday at 4 PM.
